examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The site's navigation with its four mega-menus, the Pricing link and the account actions. Widen past `xl` to see the menus in the bar; below it, open the sheet with the menu button. Search stays in the bar at every width: the field with its ⌘K keycap (Ctrl K off a Mac) on a wide bar, a magnifier button beside the call to action on a tablet or phone, and no keycap on a touch screen. Click it or press the shortcut to open the same palette.
